evidence.ref: .warp/runlog.py is the Run Lens live substrate: a per-run folder under the git common dir at warp/runs/<run-id>/ (shared across worktrees, outside git history) with a write-once meta.json, an atomically written state.json (temp file plus os.replace, fsync), a sequence-numbered append-only live.jsonl, and a commands inbox; set_state merges atomically, append_live is monotonic from 0 and read_live is gap-detectable and tolerates a torn trailing line, classify returns active/blocked/stale/done with terminal winning, an explicit blocker winning over a stale heartbeat, and an absent or aged heartbeat classifying stale (never blocked). Five durable run milestones (run.started/blocked/resumed/done/aborted) were added to EVENT_TYPES in both events.py copies; run.step and run.heartbeat are live-only and absent from the committed vocabulary. Runs root resolves from git-common-dir with a WARP_RUNS_ROOT override for tests.
